final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: CHMURNIK campaign poetic cloud close-up, one clean image, NEW artwork.
Create a landscape 3:2 poetic close-up of the side of one richly textured ivory cumulus. Strong warm side light reveals its distinct sculptural lobes, luminous outer contours and a darker violet-tinted base. The cloud fills much of the frame but leaves generous warm blush atmospheric negative space; only a tiny olive horizon appears along the lower edge. Emphasize vivid readable shape and material texture. Calm luminous afternoon, no sinister storm.
Style/medium: sophisticated adult editorial tactile wool-felt cloud sculpture above a cut-paper miniature olive landscape, art-directed not childish. Delicate irregular natural wool fibers, subtle paper textures and refined dimensional forms; strong graphic composition.
Color palette: cream ivory, warm blush pink, olive terrain, restrained violet atmospheric accents and cloud-base shadows.
Lighting/mood: warm directional side light with soft restrained glow, beautifully modeled lobes and darker base, luminous not harsh or ominous.
Constraints: one single landscape image in 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 1536 x 1024 pixels. No faces, no characters, no people, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no fake UI, no borders, no panels, no contact sheet.
